programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The Lipoma Whisperer'. Melissa covered her huge lipoma with a sweatshirt for years. Tyler's fear of cancer stopped his head lumps being diagnosed and Tahj is covered in painful boils.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Samurai Castles
programme.desc: A castle 200km north of Tokyo was a battleground in Japan's last civil war in the mid-19th century - modern warfare did not bring it down. We look at the secrets to the its strengths and its lords.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Daniel Moore takes a cinematic journey through Nagano - he hits the south in springtime to experience the breathtaking cherry blossoms and gets lost in magical winter landscapes up north.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: Edo's Rush Hour: Edo was a city of waterways, the Yoroi Ferry transported people across the Nihonbashi River, a main commercial artery. A captain's job was high-pressure and required skill and guts.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Many mountains in Japan that attract tourists are active volcanoes - learn safety tips for climbing and the latest on eruption prediction research.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Niigata / Nishizawa Ryue (architect). In a coastal district, boat builders used their skills to make houses. Nishizawa considers how architecture is affected by a community's terrain and values.

programme.title: Kabuki Kool
programme.desc: Kataoka Ainosuke takes his first turn as our host. Ainosuke is a renowned kabuki actor. He'll be our guide to the attractions of kabuki looking at some of the roles he's played.

programme.title: Philippines' Stateless Japanese
programme.desc: After WWII, thousands of children born to Japanese fathers were left behind in the Philippines - many became stateless. Eighty years on, 50 descendants are still fighting to be recognised as Japanese.

programme.title: Living Through Fire
programme.desc: Tokyo's oldest izakaya - with its traditional fare and lucky cats surviving wars and pandemics - has been a place to feel at ease for over 100 years.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Project X: Unsung Heroes
programme.desc: The true story of how amateur translators brought a manga about the Hiroshima atomic bombing to the US and the world, bridging cultural divides and spreading a message of peace.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Tune in to J-Melo for great Japanese music! On the show this week: popular Hello! Project idol group Angerme and internationally acclaimed heavy metal band Lovebites.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Little Charo is an animation series about a Japanese dog who got lost in NY. I want to see my owner again! Charo starts his adventure back home. Season 1-18.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: There's an increasing focus on repair as the need for circular economies grows - we see broken appliances being rebuilt at the circuit board level and old clothes being given creative makeovers.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Umekichi spends his time roaming through Ryogoku, a neighbourhood that's the home of sumo. Chaou lives in an apartment that was part of an Olympic Village. He relaxes in a room overlooking the city.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights
programme.desc: We visit Oita, famous for its hot springs, meeting a couple who run an inn popular with visitors from abroad and an artist interacting with locals through her art.

programme.title: The Wakey Show
programme.desc: This episode features 'Wakey's Door' on hair dryers, 'Become an Athlete for three minutes,' with karate exercises, and a music performance, 'Plants Song.' It energises kids.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Bologna, a city in northern Italy, has been a commercial and transportation hub since ancient Rome - the pride of the city is Bologna University and porticoes which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Journey
